exposureStatement: Written AFTER ml-strategy-tournament-v1 (#329) and its independent audit (#330) were read: the author has seen that the industry-momentum rule won mainly in 2017, 2023 and 2025 (defense and semiconductors). Every state variable, window, threshold, sleeve and policy below is fixed from pre-existing repository constants, literature, or round numbers BEFORE any sleeve or cocktail return in this study is computed, and none is chosen to fit those years. A chronological walk-forward on this history is development evidence, not independent or prospective validation.

inputs.pitMatrix: kr-alpha-atlas Phase B matrix (digest 32e49b57...), PIT Top120, weekly signal dates, reused from ml-strategy-tournament-v1/prepare_dataset.py
inputs.prices: replay-v16 total-return closes at signal-history 4ea107ed, with the 2026-09-14 session replaced by docs/audits/kr-alpha-atlas-phase-c-integrity/corrected-inputs.json finalSessionQuotes

withheldSecurities.006800.KS: corrected-inputs.json stockRules WITHHOLD_FULL_SECURITY_PRICE_BASIS (unresolved 2018 and 2026 corporate-action basis); never selectable by any sleeve. The number of rebalances on which a sleeve's own ranking would have picked it is reported, so the pre-removal is visible rather than silent.

inputs.macroPanel: replay-v16 macro component (FRED daily market series only), vix component, fx/USD_KRW component (DEXKOUS)

timing.krSignal: KR close 15:30 KST (06:30 UTC) on the signal date; trades execute at the close of the NEXT KR session
timing.usClose: 16:00 New York = 21:00 UTC (EST) / 20:00 UTC (EDT) on the previous US calendar day, i.e. before the KR close of the following KR day
timing.lagRule: a series value is visible on KR signal date D only if its observation date <= D - lagCalendarDays
timing.vixLagClass: FRED_DAILY_MARKET (4): the replay vix object does not name its vendor, so the more conservative registered class is used

KR_EQUITY.BREADTH_200: Phase B H09: share of measured PIT Top120 above their 200-session mean (same-date)
KR_EQUITY.IND_DISPERSION: Phase B H05: cross-industry dispersion of industry relative 126-session momentum (same-date)
KR_EQUITY.CONCENTRATION_TOP2: Phase B H10: Samsung Electronics + SK Hynix share of Top120 cap (same-date)
KR_EQUITY.LEADERSHIP_PERSIST: Phase B H07: rank persistence of industry leadership (same-date)

US_RATES.UST10_CHG_63: DGS10 change over 63 sessions in percentage points; POSITIVE = yields up = Treasury PRICES down (lag 4)
US_RATES.CURVE_CHG_63: change of the 10y-2y spread over 63 sessions (lag 4)

DOLLAR_FX.BROAD_DOLLAR_CHG_63: log change of DTWEXBGS (broad trade-weighted dollar) over 63 sessions (lag 8, H.10)
DOLLAR_FX.USDKRW_CHG_63: log change of DEXKOUS (KRW per USD; positive = KRW weaker) over 63 sessions (lag 8, H.10). A separate variable from the broad dollar
DOLLAR_FX.USDKRW_VOL_63: annualised volatility of daily DEXKOUS log changes over 63 observations (lag 8)

DYNAMIC_RELATIONS.CORR_KR_USDKRW_126: 126-session rolling correlation of 069500 daily return with the daily DEXKOUS log change, both as visible on each KR date
DYNAMIC_RELATIONS.CORR_KR_UST10_126: 126-session rolling correlation of 069500 daily return with the daily DGS10 change (yield, not price), as visible on each KR date

SLEEVE_HISTORY.REL63_<k>: sleeve k standalone NAV over 069500 over the trailing 63 sessions (realised, hence matured by construction)

stateVariables.windowsFixedBecause: 63 / 126 / 252 sessions are the repository's standing quarter / half-year / year conventions (horizon labels H63/H126/H252 in every prior study); none was chosen from returns in this study
stateVariables.standardisation: for learned models, each state variable is z-scored with the TRAINING rows' mean and standard deviation only

unavailableOrExcluded.GOLD: no gold price or gold ETF series exists in the repository snapshot; not substituted
unavailableOrExcluded.US_TREASURY_PRICE_OR_TOTAL_RETURN: no Treasury ETF or total-return index in the snapshot; the yield change is used and labelled as a yield, never as a bond price
unavailableOrExcluded.HY_SPREAD_IG_SPREAD: the replay macro panel carries ICE BofA spreads only from 2023-09 (FRED's licensed 3-year window); cannot cover the 2014-2026 study window
unavailableOrExcluded.CPI_PCE_PAYROLLS_UNEMPLOYMENT_CFNAI_M2_N: monthly or re-estimated series with no retained ALFRED vintage in the repository (Macro vintage invariants v2.9); revised values are never used
unavailableOrExcluded.KR_RATES: ECOS / OECD Korean rates are REVISED_HISTORY by the repository contract (kr_market_risk_sources)

sleeves.common: rebalance every 4th weekly signal date; quality mask of ml-strategy-tournament-v1 (tradable at signal, not preferred, 20/20 traded sessions, no stale-suspension, median traded value >= 5bn KRW); top 5 by score at 20% each; fewer than 5 scored eligible names -> the remainder in 069500; ties broken by ticker
sleeves.S1_INDUSTRY_MOMENTUM: score = rank(H01_industryRelMom126) + 0.01 * rank(A09_industryRelativeMomentum126), the ml-strategy-tournament-v1 RULE_INDUSTRY_MOMENTUM formula, WITHOUT that study's calibration gate (the plain rule)
sleeves.S2_VALUE_CONFIRMED: kr-alpha-signal-v2 H2 construction as carried by Phase B B08: names with b08Confirmed == 1, ranked by B08_valueBusinessConfirmation (within-industry value percentile)
sleeves.S3_FOUR_FACTOR: mean of available within-date ranks of A07_momentum12_1, B01_bookToMarket, C02_returnOnEquity and (1 - rank F02_downsideVol126); the ml-strategy-tournament-v1 RULE_FOUR_FACTOR formula
sleeves.S4_RISK_MANAGED_ETF: 069500 x the sealed kr-market-risk overlay C0 multiplier (Phase B I01, {1.0, 0.7, 0.4}) + remainder in cash at the BOK policy-rate proxy. RESEARCH REFERENCE ONLY: not in any cocktail choice set
sleeves.SX_XGB_SENSITIVITY: ml-strategy-tournament-v1 XGB_CI_RANK_h1 forced top-5 scores. Rejected investment candidate; shown as an explanatory standalone sensitivity only, never in a choice set

engine.accounting: self-financing share units: units are only changed by a trade; a security that cannot trade keeps its units; costs are charged on the traded value and the post-trade NAV solves NAV_post = NAV_pre - cost(NAV_post) (fixes the two approximations #330 found in ml-strategy-tournament-v1/tournament.simulate)
engine.termination: a held name with no close after its last priced session is written off (primary, conservative). Alternative: converted to the ETF at its last close. Neither is a measured consideration and neither is called a bound
engine.cash: accrues the dated BOK policy-rate proxy (data/bok-policy-rates.json); BOK_POLICY_RATE_PROXY, not an investable deposit return

cocktails.decision: same every-4th-weekly signal dates as the sleeves; the cocktail's book is the weighted sum of the chosen sleeves' target books, so overlapping names net and the engine charges only the net trade
cocktails.noChangeBand: the sleeve weights are left unchanged unless the half-sum of absolute weight changes exceeds 0.10 (sleeves still rebalance their own names)
cocktails.A1_MOMENTUM_CRASH_GUARD: S1 100%, except S0 100% when the market is in a rebound state (MKT_TREND_252 < 0 and MKT_TREND_63 > 0) or MKT_VOL_63 exceeds the 80th percentile of its own past (expanding, >= 252 sessions). Daniel & Moskowitz (2016) momentum-crash conditions; 0.80 = kr_market_risk_anatomy.HIGH_STATE_PERCENTILE
cocktails.A2_INVERSE_VOL_RISK_BUDGET: w_k proportional to 1 / sigma_k over the choice set, sigma_k = 63-session realised volatility of the sleeve's daily return
cocktails.B1_RIDGE_ALL_STATES: per risky sleeve k in {S1,S2,S3}: Ridge(alpha=10) of the next-63-session sleeve-minus-S0 return on all standardised state variables + that sleeve's REL63/REL126; trained only on decision dates whose 63-session exit is strictly before the current decision date (expanding); minimum 36 training dates, otherwise 100% S0
cocktails.B2_LGBM_ALL_STATES: as B1 with LightGBM regression (n_estimators 50, max_depth 2, num_leaves 4, learning_rate 0.05, min_child_samples 10, subsample 0.8, seed 7)
cocktails.B3_RIDGE_KR_ONLY: as B1 with KR_EQUITY + SLEEVE_HISTORY variables only (ablation: does the US rates / dollar / VIX layer add anything)
cocktails.learnedAllocation: mu_k = predicted 63-session relative return; shrink by kappa_k = mu_k^2 / (mu_k^2 + se_k^2), se_k = the ridge/LGBM conditional-mean standard error from the training design (LGBM: the matched ridge se), inflated by sqrt(63/20) for overlapping targets; edge_k = kappa_k * mu_k - round-trip switch cost; risky weight w_k = edge_k / sum(edge) * min(1, sum(edge) / 0.05) over positive edges; the rest in S0. 0.05 = a 5% 63-session relative edge for full commitment, fixed here, not tuned
cocktails.hmm: no latent-state smoothing of any kind

controls.STATIC_EW4: 25% each of S0, S1, S2, S3
controls.TREND_200_CASH: 069500 100% when its close is above its 200-session mean on the signal date, otherwise cash
controls.SLEEVE_MOMENTUM_SWITCH: 100% in the choice-set sleeve with the highest trailing 126-session NAV return (naive adaptive control)

evaluation.cocktailEvaluationStart: 2018-01-01 (all policies and controls on the identical calendar, sessions and costs)
metrics: returns in the 63 sessions after a weight change >= 0.25
loss when the learned top edge is within its own standard error
regret vs the realised best sleeve
evaluation.inference: 126-session date-synchronised circular block bootstrap (2,000 reps, seed 11) of each dynamic policy minus STATIC_EW4 and minus S0; Holm over the dynamic policies; arithmetic-plus-compounding split of the gross gap (selection_value convention)
evaluation.q1: for each sleeve-minus-S0 and S1-minus-S3 relative return at 21 / 63 / 126 sessions, on the every-4th-week decision sample 2014-2026: OLS slope on the expanding-standardised state, Newey-West lags = horizon/20, Benjamini-Yekutieli q=0.10 over every (pair, horizon, variable) cell; plus walk-forward out-of-sample R^2 of B1 against the expanding historical mean
evaluation.decomposition: dynamic minus STATIC_EW4: (1) sleeve-timing effect = sum over days of (w_dyn - w_static) . r_sleeves; (2) market-exposure and (3) industry-exposure = regression of the daily difference on 069500 and on the S1-minus-S0 daily return; (4) stock selection = 0 by construction (the same fixed sleeves); (5) arithmetic vs compounding split; (6) cost difference
evaluation.postHocDiagnostics: labelled POST_HOC: 2025 removed; CAPITAL_GOODS_DEFENSE and ELECTRONICS_ELECTRICAL removed from every sleeve universe (sleeves re-selected); cost x2; never used to choose a policy
